fusions.name: Scratching Post
fusions.desc: A quick scratch that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pounce and Unzip
fusions.desc: You spring up to 5 tiles onto the target and drag your claws down it for 14 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Covered Over
fusions.desc: Scrapes up to 2 conditions off you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Playing With It
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
